title: Motorcycle Mechanics & Ride Preparation: Pre-Ride Inspection (T-CLOCS) & Controls
description: Specialized motorcycle riding English module covering the T-CLOCS pre-ride inspection, friction zone control, and drive chain maintenance.
learning_objectives: Master essential motorcycle mechanics terms (T-CLOCS inspection, friction zone, drive chain slack, brake caliper, tire pressure)
Apply imperative instructions and prepositions of sequence to pre-ride preparation
Eliminate Czech interference errors when discussing bike controls, maintenance, and riding safety

questions.prompt: Before heading out on a mountain tour, motorcyclists _____ cold tire pressures using a calibrated pressure gauge.

explanations.correct: Modal 'must' is followed directly by the bare infinitive 'check' without 'to'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to' is ungrammatical; modal verbs never take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po způsobovém slovesu 'must' následuje vždy základní tvar bez 'to': 'must check' (nikdy *must to check*).

questions.prompt: If the rider _____ the clutch lever smoothly within the friction zone, low-speed U-turns remain completely stable.

explanations.correct: First conditional if-clause takes Present Simple ('feathers') for physical riding rules.
explanations.wrong_A: Cannot use future modal 'will' inside an if-clause.
explanations.wrong_B: Cannot use 'would' in a real First Conditional.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense 'feathered' would conflict with present indicative 'remain'.

questions.cz_learning_point: V podmínkových větách s 'if' se nesmí použít 'will' (*If the rider will feather*). Použijte přítomný čas: 'If the rider feathers'.

questions.prompt: It is recommended to apply dedicated motorcycle chain lubricant _____ the chain is still warm after a ride.

explanations.correct: 'While' is a conjunction followed by a full continuous or linking clause ('the chain is still warm').
explanations.wrong_B: 'During' is a preposition and must be followed by a noun phrase, not a clause with a verb.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Since' denotes elapsed time from a starting point or causation.

questions.cz_learning_point: Spojka 'while' se pojí s celou větou se slovesem (while the chain is warm), zatímco 'during' se pojí pouze s podstatným jménem.

questions.prompt: Motorcycle brake pads _____ immediately if the friction material thickness wears below 1.5 millimeters.

explanations.correct: Passive with modal 'must be replaced' correctly describes safety maintenance requirements.
explanations.wrong_A: Active 'must replace' implies brake pads replace themselves.
explanations.wrong_B: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modal 'must' does not take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Trpný rod se způsobovým slovesem: 'must be replaced' (musí být vyměněny). Brzdové destičky se samy nevyměňují.

questions.prompt: The motorcycle workshop technician _____ the drive chain tension and rear wheel alignment yesterday.

explanations.correct: Specific completed past time indicator 'yesterday' strictly requires Past Simple 'adjusted'.
explanations.wrong_A: Present Perfect 'has adjusted' cannot accompany finished past time 'yesterday'.
explanations.wrong_B: Present Simple expresses habitual routines, not yesterday's finished event.
explanations.wrong_D: Present Continuous describes current actions, not yesterday's events.

questions.cz_learning_point: S příslovečným určením jako 'yesterday' se v angličtině striktně pojí minulý čas prostý (Past Simple: 'adjusted'), nikoli předpřítomný čas.

questions.prompt: Riders accelerate and brake progressively on the first few kilometers _____ motorcycle tires can reach optimal operating temperature.

explanations.correct: 'So that' is a conjunction of purpose followed by a subject and modal verb clause ('tires can reach').
explanations.wrong_C: 'because of' is followed by a noun phrase, not a clause with a finite verb.

questions.cz_learning_point: Účelová spojka 'so that' = aby (následovaná podmětem a způsobovým slovesem: 'so that tires can reach').

questions.prompt: An integrated slipper clutch prevents the rear wheel from _____ when shifting down aggressively into corners.

explanations.correct: Preposition 'from' is followed by the '-ing' gerund form: 'locking up'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'locking up of' adds an unnecessary preposition.
explanations.wrong_C: Base form 'lock up' cannot follow preposition 'from'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po předložkách (jako 'from') následuje v angličtině sloveso s koncovkou -ing: 'prevents the rear wheel from locking up' (zablokování zadního kola).

questions.prompt: The streetfighter motorcycle features an aluminum twin-spar perimeter frame, _____ provides exceptional torsional stiffness.

explanations.correct: Relative pronoun 'which' correctly refers back to the antecedent inanimate noun 'frame'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'that' cannot be used in non-defining relative clauses set off by commas.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vztažné zájmeno pro věci v doplňovacích větách (oddělených čárkou) je 'which': 'perimeter frame, which provides...' (nikoli *that*).

questions.prompt: If the starter motor turns over briskly but the engine produces no spark whatsoever, the emergency handlebar kill switch _____ activated.

explanations.correct: 'Must be' expresses logical deduction based on electrical symptoms.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modals never take 'to'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'can to be' is ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Logická dedukce (určitě je / musí být aktivován): 'must be activated'. Způsobová slovesa nepřibírají předložku 'to'.

questions.prompt: The motorcycle engine will immediately cut out when clicking into first gear _____ the sidestand has been fully retracted.

explanations.correct: 'Unless' expresses 'except if' or 'if not', stating the mandatory safety interlock condition.
explanations.wrong_A: 'if' produces an illogical statement (cuts out IF retracted).
explanations.wrong_C: 'provided that' creates an illogical positive condition.
explanations.wrong_D: 'as long as' also creates an illogical condition.

questions.cz_learning_point: 'Unless' = pokud ne (if not). Po 'unless' už v angličtině nenásleduje další zápor: 'unless the sidestand has been retracted'.
